agent: Codex parent, consolidating a read-only CCR network worker and parent login probes
scope: Live identity-based discovery of B550 and Strix after simultaneous reboots, including tests over both Mac Wi-Fi and Mac Ethernet. This records connectivity and identity only; it does not modify either remote host or claim engine health.

method.fixed_ip_policy: No historical IPv4 address was trusted as identity. Router DNS, live ARP/NDP, SSH host-key fingerprints, reported hostname, and machine IDs supplied the proof.

checks.command: dns-sd/dig/ARP/NDP discovery plus ssh-keyscan by the read-only network worker
checks.result: both hosts matched router reverse DNS, current neighbor MACs, and stored SSH keys; alternate ZeroTier candidates did not

checks.command: ssh -4 -b <live en0/en13 source> <live DNS answer> with HostKeyAlias and BatchMode
checks.result: all four host/link combinations logged in and returned the expected hostname and machine-id

checks.command: remote ip -br addr, ip route, and /sys/class/net operstate probes
checks.result: each target currently routes through its wired interface; both target Wi-Fi interfaces are down

non_claims: The current IPv4 addresses are observations, not stable identities, and must be rediscovered on every operational run.
This finding does not prove the remote Wi-Fi radios are defective; they are administratively or driver-level down on the target hosts for this probe.
No remote network configuration, service, route, or DNS record was changed.
No Strata engine, GPU, storage, or model-health claim follows from network reachability.
